issues.description: Method Lecture.toString(): the solution implementation declares the method with return type Object (public Object toString()) while the problem statement and Java conventions expect toString() to return String. The problem description asks students to implement a custom toString() (problem_statement.md refers to a String example), and the template has a TODO for adding the custom toString method. Declaring public Object toString() in the solution is an incompatible return-type change relative to java.lang.Object.toString() (which returns String) and will cause a compilation error and confusion for students who follow the exercise instructions.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the toString() method signature in the solution to return String (public String toString()) and annotate it with @Override. Keep the existing string concatenation/formatting but ensure the method returns a String. Update the solution file at src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java accordingly so it correctly overrides java.lang.Object.toString() and compiles; ensure the template and problem statement remain consistent with returning String.
